Hunting for Old Pipes in Colonial Virginia

The hunt club I hunt with leases land from farmers around Southern VA. When the farmers around here till up the fields you can find arrow heads and old clay pipes just laying on the ground. Over the years I've found hundreds of arrow heads and a few clay pipes. Usually the pipes are broken but it's still cool to find them. Some of them even have makers marks stamped on them. A friend of mine has found some bone pipes in the fields also. The best way to find them is to wait for the farmers to till up the fields before they plant. I have the best luck at finding stuff around Franklin, VA and Williamsburg, VA. One guy I know has found a bunch of pipes in the Pungo area of Virginia Beach around Back Bay and on the Chesapeake side of the Dismal Swamp. I've given all mine to a collector I know but I'm thinking about going over his house to take pictures of them so I can post the pictures here.
